axi_adapter_wr.summary: AXI write-channel width adapter: a 4-state FSM accepts AW bursts, repacks write data (pass, merge or split) with burst counters, and drives a skid-buffered master W channel and response return.

blocks.name: Write FSM
blocks.description: Sequences AW accept, data transfer states and response collection

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/DATA/DATA_2/RESP controller sequencing address accept, data repacking and response return

anchors.name: burst_active_reg
anchors.why: Slave burst still active; RESP re-issues new master burst instead of idling

anchors.name: first_transfer_reg
anchors.why: First split burst flag; gates bresp capture

blocks.name: Burst tracking
blocks.description: Address and beat counters for slave and master bursts

anchors.name: addr_reg
anchors.why: Running burst address; selects segment offsets and re-issued master address

anchors.name: burst_reg
anchors.why: Remaining slave beats counter; ends merge burst and drives burst_active

anchors.name: master_burst_reg
anchors.why: Remaining master beats counter; ends split master burst to RESP

anchors.name: burst_size_reg
anchors.why: Latched slave awsize used for address increment

anchors.name: master_burst_size_reg
anchors.why: Master beat size used for address increment and word boundary checks

blocks.name: Address channel
blocks.description: Captures slave AW, recomputes length/size, issues master AW

anchors.name: s_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: Slave write-address valid; starts a new burst in IDLE

anchors.name: s_axi_awready
anchors.why: Slave AW ready from s_axi_awready_reg, asserted in IDLE when master AW free

anchors.name: s_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Slave burst start address captured into addr_reg and master AW

anchors.name: m_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Master burst address, reissued from addr_reg for split bursts

anchors.name: m_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: Master AW valid set on burst start or burst re-issue

blocks.name: Width conversion datapath
blocks.description: Passes, merges or splits slave write data into master-width words

anchors.name: s_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Slave write data repacked into master-width words

anchors.name: s_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: Slave write data valid; qualifies data transfer in DATA states

anchors.name: s_axi_wready
anchors.why: Slave write ready, follows internal early-ready of output buffer

anchors.name: data_reg
anchors.why: Accumulates merged segments or holds wide word being split

anchors.name: strb_reg
anchors.why: Strobe companion of data_reg during merge/split

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata_int
anchors.why: Repacked write word from FSM feeding output skid buffer

anchors.name: m_axi_wvalid_int
anchors.why: Internal valid of repacked word into output buffer

blocks.name: Output skid buffer
blocks.description: Two-entry register slice driving master W channel

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Master write data from output skid register

anchors.name: m_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: Master write data valid from m_axi_wvalid_reg

anchors.name: m_axi_wready
anchors.why: Master write ready; steers skid-buffer transfers and early ready

anchors.name: m_axi_wready_int_reg
anchors.why: Internal ready of output buffer; gates stores and split DATA_2 progress

anchors.name: temp_m_axi_wdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp data held when master not ready

anchors.name: temp_m_axi_wvalid_reg
anchors.why: Temp skid slot occupied; affects early ready and output refill

anchors.name: store_axi_w_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads internal word directly into output register

anchors.name: store_axi_w_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Loads internal word into temp skid register

anchors.name: store_axi_w_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Selects temp register as output register source

blocks.name: Write response
blocks.description: Collects master B responses and returns merged response with stored ID

anchors.name: s_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid to slave, set when final master response received

anchors.name: s_axi_bready
anchors.why: Slave response ready clears s_axi_bvalid

anchors.name: m_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Master write response valid; completes RESP state

anchors.name: m_axi_bready
anchors.why: Master response ready asserted in RESP state

anchors.name: s_axi_bresp
anchors.why: Write response code returned from master bresp

anchors.name: id_reg
anchors.why: Latched AW ID returned on s_axi_bid

axi_adapter_rd.summary: AXI read-channel width adapter: an FSM forwards or re-sizes AR bursts to the master side, then splits or merges R beats via address tracking and a data register, emitting through a skid-buffered output stage.

blocks.name: Adapter FSM
blocks.description: Sequences AR forwarding and R beat split/merge conversion.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Adapter FSM: idle, data, data_read, data_split sequencing AR issue and R beat conversion.

anchors.name: s_axi_arsize
anchors.why: Burst size decides split, merge or pass-through conversion.

blocks.name: Burst tracking
blocks.description: Address and beat counters for slave and master bursts.

anchors.name: addr_reg
anchors.why: Tracks current beat address; selects data segment and detects word boundaries.

anchors.name: burst_reg
anchors.why: Remaining slave-side beats; ends burst at zero.

anchors.name: master_burst_reg
anchors.why: Remaining master-side beats; triggers new master burst at zero.

anchors.name: burst_size_reg
anchors.why: Latched slave burst size for address increment.

anchors.name: master_burst_size_reg
anchors.why: Latched master burst size for boundary detection.

blocks.name: Width conversion datapath
blocks.description: Segments wide beats or merges narrow beats into slave data width.

anchors.name: data_reg
anchors.why: Holds wide master beat for splitting or accumulates narrow beats when merging.

anchors.name: resp_reg
anchors.why: Accumulated read response for merged/split beats.

anchors.name: id_reg
anchors.why: Latched AR ID returned on s_axi_rid_int.

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata_int
anchors.why: Converted read data feeding skid buffer output stage.

blocks.name: AR channel forwarding
blocks.description: Registered master AR outputs derived from slave AR request.

anchors.name: s_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: Slave AR request valid; accepted in idle to start a burst.

anchors.name: s_axi_arready
anchors.why: Slave AR ready, registered from FSM when no master AR pending.

anchors.name: s_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Slave read address, copied to m_axi_araddr_next and addr_next.

anchors.name: s_axi_arlen
anchors.why: Slave burst length, loaded into burst_next and used to compute master arlen.

anchors.name: m_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: Master AR valid, set on new burst and held until arready.

anchors.name: m_axi_arready
anchors.why: Master AR ready clears m_axi_arvalid_next.

anchors.name: m_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Master read address, from slave address or recomputed for split bursts.

anchors.name: m_axi_arlen
anchors.why: Master burst length, recomputed when resizing bursts.

blocks.name: R output skid buffer
blocks.description: Two-register skid buffer driving slave R channel with registered ready.

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Slave read data output from output register.

anchors.name: s_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Slave R valid from skid-buffer output stage.

anchors.name: s_axi_rready
anchors.why: Slave R ready; drives skid buffer transfers and rready_int_early.

anchors.name: s_axi_rvalid_int
anchors.why: Internal R valid from FSM into output skid buffer.

anchors.name: s_axi_rready_int_reg
anchors.why: Internal ready from skid buffer back to FSM.

anchors.name: temp_s_axi_rdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp data register when output stalled.

anchors.name: temp_s_axi_rvalid_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer occupied flag gating ready_int_early.

anchors.name: store_axi_r_int_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable for output data registers from internal path.

blocks.name: Master R input
blocks.description: Accepts master read beats with registered rready.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Master read data, shifted/split or merged into data_reg.

anchors.name: m_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Master R valid, gates beat acceptance in data states.

anchors.name: m_axi_rready
anchors.why: Master R ready, registered from FSM and downstream readiness.

axi_adapter.summary: AXI4 width adapter wrapper: independent write-channel and read-channel adapter instances convert slave-side bursts to master-side data width; no logic of its own.

blocks.name: Write channel adapter
blocks.description: Write adapter instance resizing AW/W bursts and returning B responses.

anchors.name: s_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: Slave write address valid into write adapter.

anchors.name: s_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Slave write burst address into write adapter.

anchors.name: s_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Slave-width write data repacked by write adapter.

anchors.name: s_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: Slave write data valid into write adapter.

anchors.name: s_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid returned to slave side.

anchors.name: m_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: Master-side write address from write adapter.

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: Master-width write data from write adapter.

blocks.name: Read channel adapter
blocks.description: Read adapter instance resizing AR bursts and R data beats.

anchors.name: s_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: Slave read address valid into read adapter.

anchors.name: s_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Slave read burst address into read adapter.

anchors.name: s_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Slave-width read data produced by read adapter.

anchors.name: s_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: Read data valid to slave side.

anchors.name: m_axi_araddr
anchors.why: Master-side read address from read adapter.

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Master-width read data into read adapter.
